tags.description: A slim comic in a plain sleeve, forty pages, stapled through the spine. The cover is a man in a municipal utility tabard standing in a stairwell with a clipboard, drawn from below so he looks enormous, and the tagline runs up the side: HE ONLY WANTS THE NUMBER. This is a reading copy, which is the trade’s way of saying it has been read: the spine is rolled, the corners are soft, and somebody’s thumb has worn a pale patch into the bottom right of every page.
